{{Top|leg}}
The '''Republic Xenosociological Database''' was a storehouse of sociological data pertaining to numerous [[Sentience/Legends|sapient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and maintained by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its last decades of existence.

==Known entries in the database==
*Subdirectory ORTNS23/917-NAN21: The [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] species and its culture
*Subdirectory ORT23/123,983-NAN21SD: The [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] etiquette of the Neimoidians
*Subdirectory ORT831-23,794,928/1N: The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and their culture
*Subdirectory RS-12962/NG-54X: The Gungan technology and its development
